description: OSv-specific modifications to ZFS (based on illumos/FreeBSD ZFS port)
base_version: illumos ZFS as ported to FreeBSD ~2013 (pre-OpenZFS unification)

files.description: Complete rewrite of vdev_disk for OSv bio layer integration. Replaces FreeBSD GEOM/devfs with OSv device/bio APIs.
ARC memory management adaptations: disable DNLC purge, add vm_throttling_needed() check, disable FreeBSD-specific memory throttle and prefetch tuning, skip ru_inblock accounting.
Stub out unsupported ioctl operations (destroy, rollback, recv, send, diff, userspace, jail/unjail). Disable security policy checks. Skip onexit cleanup registration.
Replace FreeBSD ZFS_LOG macro (mtx-locked printf with optional kdb_backtrace) with simple kprintf-based logging.
Disable mandatory lock checks, mapped read path, xvattr handling, and vrecycle in zfs_inactive. OSv VFS layer lacks these features.
Disable sync, skip security policy on unmount, use release_mp_dentries instead of vflush, abort on snapshot ctl operations, sync all pools on last dataset unmount.
Add manual reference counting (z_ref_cnt) to znodes since OSv lacks vnode-level reference counting. Simplify device number conversion macros.
Add z_ref_cnt field to znode_t struct for OSv reference counting.

Remove all DNLC (Directory Name Lookup Cache) operations. OSv does not have DNLC. Also disable vnode mount point locking (vn_vfswlock/vn_vfsunlock). Align with FreeBSD for xattr error codes (ENOATTR).
Follow FreeBSD behavior for ACL: group ID inheritance from parent dir, skip ADS permission checks, skip xattr vnode release, device vnode write check.
Stub out ZIL replay functions that depend on unsupported features: TX_CREATE_ACL, TX_LINK, TX_SETATTR, TX_ACL_V0, TX_ACL. Also disable vattr init and xvattr replay helpers.
Provide OSv-specific zpool_get_config() and spa_generate_rootconf() using vdev_disk_read_rootlabel(). Also follow FreeBSD pattern for reguid history logging.
Disable jail-based zone hostname lookup in spa_history_zone().
Stub out GEOM-based zvol operations: DECLARE_GEOM_CLASS, zvol_size_changed, zvol_minor_lookup, zvol_remove_minors, zvol_geom_create, zvol_create_minors, zvol_rename_minors.
Force PAGESIZE alignment for zio data buffer cache allocation.
Skip zfsvfs_update_fromname and zvol_rename_minors calls on dataset rename.
Skip zfs_unmount_snap, zvol_rename_minors, zfs_secpolicy_rename_perms, onexit hold cleanup, and onexit fd release. Abort on temporary snapshot creation with cleanup_fd.
Skip zfs_secpolicy_snapshot permission check on recursive snapshots. Abort on temporary snapshot with cleanup_fd. Skip onexit hold registration and fd release.
Skip ru_oublock accounting (curthread->td_ru.ru_oublock++) on DMU write.
Make zfs_prop_values() available in kernel mode on OSv (normally userspace-only).
Make zpool_prop_values() available in kernel mode on OSv (normally userspace-only).
Make zprop_width() available in kernel mode on OSv (normally userspace-only).

external_files.description: Constructor-based ZFS initialization. Registers callbacks for ioctl, ARC shrinker, pagecache, VFS ops. Uses .note.osv-mlock section for pre-faulting.
